constraints: filter supports the '@' wildcard character for "starts with"/"ends with"/"contains" matching; passing an empty string disables filtering entirely.

marker is a monotonically increasing internal database-resource modification counter: passing a value returns only forms whose marker is >= that value, and if a variable is passed, the command also writes back the new (highest) counter value into it for use as the marker in a subsequent call (incremental version-control sync pattern).

overloadMerges.note: arrNames is filled by the command (parameter table arrow '←'), so its direction should be 'out'. marker is documented and arrow-marked ('↔') as inout: it both filters (input) and is overwritten with the new counter value (output).

params.name: aTable
params.description: Table for which to return table form names; if omitted, database project form names are returned instead

params.name: arrNames
params.description: Filled with the names of forms matching filter/marker

params.name: filter
params.description: Comparison string limiting returned form names; supports '@' wildcards; empty string or omitted means no filtering

params.name: marker
params.description: In: minimum modification-counter value forms must meet to be returned. Out: overwritten with the new (highest) modification-counter value, for reuse as marker on the next call.
If passed from a component, apply the command to the host database instead of the component (ignored outside of a component context)

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Returns the names of project or table forms in the application, optionally filtered by name pattern and/or by a modification-marker cutoff used for incremental synchronization.
